def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # The non-background pattern comprises a 4x4 object at the left of
    # each 4-row band. Continue its dangling horizontal runs to the right edge
    # with the marker color 1. Demos show the third row of the 4-row motif
    # is the continuation row; here its analogue follows the upper band.
    bg = max(range(10), key=lambda k: sum(v == k for row in grid for v in row))
    color = max((k for k in range(10) if k != bg), key=lambda k: sum(v == k for row in grid for v in row))
    # Locate the top patterned section, followed by the large blank separator.
    active = [r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if any(v != bg for v in row)]
    if active:
        top_end = next((r for r in range(active[0], len(grid)) if all(v == bg for v in grid[r:])), len(grid))
        # In demos, each motif has a row with a solid run beginning at column 0,
        # then background gaps toward the right. Fill only its right-side tail.
        for r in range(active[0], top_end):
            row = grid[r]
            # identify a run whose left edge is within the first quarter
            # and whose component repeats as a band motif
            if row[0] == color and row[1] == color:
                end = 1
                while end + 1 < len(row) and row[end+1] == color:
                    end += 1
                for c in range(end+1, len(row)):
                    if row[c] == bg:
                        out[r][c] = 1
    return out
